dek: The Government announced today (August 28) that the Chief Executive has appointed Ms Melissa Kaye Pang to succeed Dr Lam Tai-fai as the Chairperson of the Radio Television Hong Kong (RTHK) Board of Advisors (Board). The Chief Executive has also reappointed 10 incumbent members and appointed two new members to the Board
